subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be narrowed to adding runtime channel/capability/shell/action metadata to slash-command prompt reconstruction now, while leaving selective reply routing to a separate follow-up?
rationale: Source inspection shows a concrete command metadata gap, but the original request also asks for prompt-driven channel selection and reply routing, which changes product behavior beyond a simple metadata repair.

options.title: Approve narrow metadata repair
options.body: Implement channel-aware runtime metadata only in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle for /context and /export-session, without changing general reply routing.

options.title: Broaden into routing design
options.body: Treat this as a larger delivery-policy/API project that defines how prompts or rules may select target channels before implementation.

options.title: Defer the whole request
options.body: Leave normal inbound channel metadata as sufficient for now and wait for stronger evidence before changing command diagnostics or routing behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow metadata repair
recommendation.body: Implement channel-aware runtime metadata only in resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle for /context and /export-session, without changing general reply routing.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history on the command prompt bundle and the existing maintainer comment already framed the same scoping question.
